arxiv-1701-01574.title: Real Multi-Sense or Pseudo Multi-Sense: An Approach to Improve Word Representation
arxiv-1701-01574.creator: Haoyue Shi, Caihua Li, Junfeng Hu
arxiv-1701-01574.description: Abstract Previous researches have shown that learning multiple representations for polysemous words can improve the performance of word embeddings on many tasks. However, this leads to another problem. Several vectors of a word may actually point to the same meaning, namely pseudo multi-sense.

arxiv-2103-06718.title: Searching for parity violation with the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA network
arxiv-2103-06718.creator: Katarina Martinovic, Charles Badger, Mairi Sakellariadou, Vuk Mandic
arxiv-2103-06718.description: Abstract A stochastic gravitational wave background is expected to emerge from the superposition of numerous gravitational wave sources of both astrophysical and cosmological origin. A number of cosmological models can have a parity violation, resulting in the generation of circularly polarised gravitational waves. We present a method to search for parity violation in the gravitational wave data.

arxiv-2106-12879.title: Decoding a class of maximum Hermitian rank metric codes
arxiv-2106-12879.creator: Wrya K. Kadir, Chunlei Li, Ferdinando Zullo
arxiv-2106-12879.description: Abstract Maximum Hermitian rank metric codes were introduced by Schmidt in 2018 and in this paper we propose both interpolation-based encoding and decoding algorithms for this family of codes when the length and the minimum distance of the code are both odd.

arxiv-2205-09314.title: Target-Guided Dialogue Response Generation Using Commonsense and Data Augmentation
arxiv-2205-09314.creator: Prakhar Gupta, Harsh Jhamtani, Jeffrey P. Bigham
arxiv-2205-09314.description: Abstract Target-guided response generation enables dialogue systems to smoothly transition a conversation from a dialogue context toward a target sentence. Such control is useful for designing dialogue systems that direct a conversation toward specific goals, such as creating non-obtrusive recommendations or introducing new topics in the conversation.

arxiv-2207-02630.title: Massive RF Simulation Applied to School Connectivity in Malawi
arxiv-2207-02630.creator: Ermanno Pietrosemoli, Marco Rainone, Marco Zennaro, Chomora Mikeka
arxiv-2207-02630.description: Abstract Providing Internet connectivity to schools has been identified as paramount for development, for instance in the Giga project, cosponsored by ITU and UNICEF, with the goal of connecting every school to the Internet by 2030. For a country wide deployment, it is imperative to perform a thorough planning of the whole installation, using radio frequency (RF) propagation models.

arxiv-2307-10070.title: Destructive relativity
arxiv-2307-10070.creator: Maria Przybylska, Wojciech Szumiński, Andrzej J. Maciejewski
arxiv-2307-10070.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Maria Przybylska, Wojciech Szumiński, Andrzej J. Maciejewski. The description of dynamics for high-energy particles requires an application of the special relativity theory framework, and analysis of properties of the corresponding equations of motion is very important. Here, we analyse Hamilton equations of motion in the limit of weak external field when potential satisfies the condition 2 ​ V ​ ( 𝒒 ) ≪ m ​ c 2 2V(\boldsymbol{q})\ll mc^{2} .

arxiv-2308-15276.title: Large Language Models in Fault Localisation CCS: Software and its engineering Software testing and debugging
arxiv-2308-15276.creator: Yonghao Wu, Zheng Li, Jie M. Zhang, Mike Papadakis, Mark Harman, Yong Liu
arxiv-2308-15276.description: Abstract . Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in multiple software engineering tasks including code generation, program repair, code summarisation, and test generation. Fault localisation is instrumental in enabling automated debugging and repair of programs and was prominently featured as a highlight during the launch event of ChatGPT-4.

arxiv-2410-09178.title: Attosecond pulses from a solid driven by a synthesized two-color field at megahertz repetition rate
arxiv-2410-09178.creator: Zhaopin Chen, Mark Levit, Yuval Kern, Basabendra Roy, Adi Goldner, Michael Krüger, ∗ Corresponding authors. Email: zhaopin.chen@campus.technion.ac.il, krueger@technion.ac.il, † These authors contributed equally to this work.

Email: zhaopin.chen@campus.technion.ac.il, krueger@technion.ac.il, † These authors contributed equally to this work.. Probing coherent quantum dynamics in light-matter interactions at the microscopic level requires high-repetition-rate isolated attosecond pulses (IAPs) in pump-probe experiments. To date, the generation of IAPs has been mainly limited to the kilohertz regime.

arxiv-2411-10241.title: On the fermionic van der Waals and Casimir-Polder interactions
arxiv-2411-10241.creator: C. D. Fosco, G. Hansen
arxiv-2411-10241.description: Abstract We formulate fermionic versions, for any number of spatial dimensions, of the van der Waals and Casimir-Polder interactions, and study their properties. In both cases, the systems we introduce contain localized ‘atoms’: two-level systems, coupled to a vacuum Dirac field. This Dirac field plays here a role akin to the electromagnetic field in the van der Waals case.

arxiv-2504-19937.title: SST-DUNet: Automated preclinical functional MRI skull stripping using Smart Swin Transformer and Dense UNet
arxiv-2504-19937.creator: Sima Soltanpour, Rachel Utama, Arnold Chang, Md Taufiq Nasseef, Dan Madularu, Praveen Kulkarni, Craig Ferris, Chris Joslin
arxiv-2504-19937.description: Abstract Skull stripping is a common preprocessing step that is often performed manually in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) pipelines, including functional MRI (fMRI). This manual process is time-consuming and operator dependent. Automating this process is challenging for preclinical data due to variations in brain geometry, resolution, and tissue contrast.

arxiv-2512-18935.title: Weak Lensing Mass Calibration of the ACT DR5 Galaxy Clusters with the DES Year 3 Weak Lensing Data
arxiv-2512-18935.creator: J. Weller
arxiv-2512-18935.description: Abstract We use weak gravitational lensing measurements from Year 3 Dark Energy Survey data to calibrate the masses of 443 galaxy clusters selected via the Sunyaev-Zel’dovich effect from Atacama Cosmology Telescope Data Release 5 maps of the cosmic microwave background.

arxiv-2512-19943.title: SE360: Semantic Edit in 360° Panoramas via Hierarchical Data Construction
arxiv-2512-19943.creator: Haoyi Zhong, Fang-Lue Zhang, Andrew Chalmers, Taehyun Rhee
arxiv-2512-19943.description: Abstract While instruction-based image editing is emerging, extending it to 360° panoramas introduces additional challenges. Existing methods often produce implausible results in both equirectangular projections (ERP) and perspective views. To address these limitations, we propose SE360, a novel framework for multi-condition guided object editing in 360° panoramas.

pmc-10511647.title: Low thalamic activity during a digit-symbol substitution task is associated with symptoms of subjective cognitive decline
pmc-10511647.creator: Akiko Mizuno, Helmet Talib Karim, Maria J. Ly, Brian J. Lopresti, Ann D. Cohen, Areej A. Ali, Chester A. Mathis, William E. Klunk, Howard J. Aizenstein, Beth E. Snitz
pmc-10511647.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionSubjective cognitive decline (SCD) may represent the earliest preclinical stage of Alzheimer's Disease (AD) for some older adults. However, the underlying neurobiology of SCD is not completely understood. Since executive function may be affected earlier than memory function in the progression of AD, we aimed to characterize SCD symptoms in terms of fMRI brain activity during the computerized digit-symbol substitution task (DSST), an executive function task.

pmc-11432765.title: Clinical and Laboratory Parameters Associated with PICU Admission in Children with Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome Associated with COVID-19 (MIS-C)
pmc-11432765.creator: Maria-Myrto Dourdouna, Evdoxia Mpourazani, Elizabeth-Barbara Tatsi, Chrysanthi Tsirogianni, Charikleia Barbaressou, Nick Dessypris, Athanasios Michos
pmc-11432765.description: Background/Objectives: Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in children (MIS-C) is a rare but severe post-infectious complication of COVID-19 that often requires admission to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU). The present study aimed to compare the demographic, clinical, and laboratory characteristics of children diagnosed with MIS-C who were admitted to the PICU and those who did not require PICU admission.

pmc-11883259.title: The effect of the pandemic on autoantibody rates in the general population
pmc-11883259.creator: Mehmet Karabey, Havva Kaya, Alperen Ceylan, Kadir Kaba, Mehmet Özdemir, Bahadır Feyzioğlu
pmc-11883259.description: Objectives The study aimed to investigate the possible effects of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) on autoantibodies. Patients and methods Samples of 89,108 individuals (29,033 males, 60,075 females; median: 36 years; range, 0 to 96 years) who underwent autoimmune testing between January 2017 and May 2022 were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-12618654.title: Comprehensive analysis of single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing uncover tumor microenvironment diversity in invasive Retinoblastoma
pmc-12618654.creator: Wei Wan, Xiaoqian Chen, Hongli Liu, Ling Yang, Pingping Huang
pmc-12618654.description: In this study, we analyzed publicly available scRNA-seq data from primary tumor tissues of 10 Retinoblastoma (RB) patients to explore tumor microenvironment (TME) heterogeneity. Our findings revealed distinct subpopulations of cone precursor (CP) cells, with higher proportions in invasive RB.

pmc-12718240.title: Identification of strong constitutive promoters in Burkholderia stagnalis TBRC 18363 for activating natural product production in Gram-negative bacteria
pmc-12718240.creator: Chayaphat Wongsombat, Wuttichai Mhuantong, Jindaporn Kongsee, Thapanee Pruksatrakul, Kitlada Srichomthong, Piyanat Charoenyingcharoen, Umaporn Uawisetwathana, Pattaraporn Yukphan, Vanicha Vichai, Dominik Pistorius, Kathrin Buntin, Aiyada Aroonsri
pmc-12718240.description: AbstractGram-negative bacteria are emerging as an important source of natural products with pharmaceutical potential. However, the limited availability of genetic tools for drug discovery and sustainable production of secondary metabolites remains a challenge. Burkholderia spp. serve as a promising source for such tools, as these bacteria produce diverse natural products and are amenable to genetic modification.

pmc-13395668.title: Niacin alleviates cerebral microvascular endothelial cell apoptosis induced by hypervirulent Klebsiella Pneumoniae by reducing the accumulation of reactive oxygen species
pmc-13395668.creator: Yinghai Zhao, Mubin Wang, Xing Che
pmc-13395668.description: IntroductionHypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae (hvKp) is an important pathogen causing central nervous system infections, including meningitis; however, the mechanisms by which it disrupts the blood-brain barrier remain unclear. Niacin, a vitamin B3 compound related to NAD+ metabolism, has the potential to regulate redox homeostasis.
